body: P1 high confidence: path_entry strips the trailing slash from scripts/, so the final match excludes descendants before confinement checks. Real CLI returns OK for an outside-pointing scripts/escape.py under scripts/ and C12 confinement under scripts/**. Owner disposition is required before another scope-filter repair.

P2 high confidence: C10's extraction regex excludes combining marks and never sends decomposed Unicode names to path_entry. Real CLI docs sentence with scripts/cafe\u0301.py pointing outside passes, while NFC spelling fails C10. The regex predates the pipeline, but this leaves an expressly required consumer outside original-path confinement.
